headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: gold changed shoulders as the ROH World Tag Team Titles found a new champion as Guevara & Rhodes vs. The Undisputed Kingdom battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.05 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Guevara & Rhodes and The Undisputed Kingdom's career. Amid a mass pre-match brawl involving nearly a dozen other wrestlers, Guevara's swanton and Rhodes' Cross Rhodes were enough to dethrone The Undisputed Kingdom for the ROH World Tag Team Titles.

Looking back to 2022, when Dragon Lee skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a genuinely great match. A shoulder-braced Kenny Omega stepped in as the Young Bucks' mystery partner and helped open the inaugural AEW World Trios Championship tournament with a win over Andrade, Rush and Dragon Lee.
Flash back to 2024, when FTR vs. The Acclaimed met in a Number One Contender, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.83 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Bryan Danielson vs. Daniel Garcia fought it out in a 2 out of 3 Falls match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 9.01 ? a match fans still talk about ? part of a stacked House of the Dragon '22 card, rated 9.01 overall.
It was 2022 when KiLynn King made their long-awaited return to AEW television after just over 11 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
Flash back to 2024, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Lio Rush locked horns for the first time on Collision, rated 6.71.
